task_description: Fix critical JWT error handling in the backend so that invalid tokens return proper HTTP 401 JSON responses instead of 500 Internal Server Errors. Affects get_current_user dependency and refresh_token_endpoint.

verification.summary: All 9 auth tests pass (6 existing + 3 new). Pre-existing failures in unrelated test files (test_anon_access, test_circuit_breaker, test_security, test_translator) confirmed to be pre-existing and unrelated to the JWT error handling changes.
